nl: Enable the setting `pl_PL.UTF-8 UTF-8` in locale.gen by removing the comment marker from its line. Other commented lines stay commented.

entries.content_utf8:
# en_US.UTF-8 UTF-8
# pl_PL.UTF-8 UTF-8
# de_DE.UTF-8 UTF-8

locale.gen.text:
# en_US.UTF-8 UTF-8
pl_PL.UTF-8 UTF-8
# de_DE.UTF-8 UTF-8

oracle_program: lines "locale.gen" |> filter text == "# pl_PL.UTF-8 UTF-8" |> replace "# pl_PL.UTF-8 UTF-8" "pl_PL.UTF-8 UTF-8" mode: literal
reference_pwsh:
$p = Join-Path $PWD 'locale.gen'
$t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
$old = '# pl_PL.UTF-8 UTF-8'
$new = 'pl_PL.UTF-8 UTF-8'
if (([regex]::Matches($t, [regex]::Escape($old))).Count -ne 1) { throw 'expected one match' }
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t.Replace($old, $new))
